brand.name: Duolingo
brand.elevatorPitch: Learn a language with quick, bite-sized lessons that make serious learning fun. Research-backed teaching methods, personalized learning, and game-like features help you build a habit and gain real-world communication skills.
brand.boilerplate: About Duolingo: Duolingo’s mission is to develop the best education in the world and make it universally available. Its language learning app combines research-backed teaching methods, delightful content, and personalized lessons to teach reading, writing, listening, and speaking. Duolingo also offers an English proficiency test, Math, Music, Chess, and discounted Super Duolingo accounts for organizations.
brand.description: Free, fun, and effective courses in languages and more. Learn with quick, science-based lessons personalized to you.

notes: Taken from the rendered site header (179x42px on a 1440px-wide viewport).

scale.sample: The most fun way to learn languages, chess, and more!
Our convenient, fast, and affordable English test integrates the latest assessment science

voice.summary: Duolingo pairs playful encouragement with learning science. It speaks directly to learners, makes progress feel achievable, and explains practical benefits without losing its sense of fun.

traits.name: Playful with a purpose
traits.description: Fun is presented as a way to sustain meaningful learning, not as a distraction from it.
traits.do: Connect playful features or short learning breaks to progress, skills, or habit-building.
traits.dont: Use jokes or game language without explaining the learning benefit.

evidence.quote: serious learning, made fun for all
Short, varied lessons make it fun to take a learning break

traits.name: Science made approachable
traits.description: Research and expertise provide credibility, while explanations remain focused on understandable learner outcomes.
traits.do: Name the scientific foundation and immediately explain what it helps learners do.
traits.dont: Bury the benefit under academic terminology or imply unsupported results.

evidence.quote: Learning with Duolingo is fun, and research shows that it works!
Combining the best of AI and language science, lessons are tailored to help you learn at just the right level and pace.

traits.name: Progress-positive
traits.description: The voice encourages steady progress, confidence, and healthy habits rather than pressure or perfection.
traits.do: Emphasize achievable steps, encouragement, and continued progress.
traits.dont: Shame learners for mistakes or frame learning as a test of personal worth.

evidence.quote: Duolingo focuses on making progress, which builds confidence and healthy habits
Employees can follow each other and send congrats for making progress

traits.name: Curious and learner-led
traits.description: Questions invite learners into a conversation, with experts positioned as helpful guides.
traits.do: Use real learner questions as headings and address the reader directly.
traits.dont: Talk down to beginners or assume readers already know specialist terms.

evidence.quote: From your nerdiest emails about learning to the science of how your brain works, you've got questions—and Duolingo experts have answers.
11 chess terms every beginner needs to know

styleRules: Use sentence-case editorial headings and lowercase promotional headings; avoid title case.
Keep explanatory sentences near 19 words on average, with short benefit-led headings to break up longer copy.
Address readers as 'you' and 'your'; use 'we' when explaining how Duolingo supports learning.
Use questions frequently in advice and FAQs, rather than making every promotional statement a question.
Use contractions for a conversational feel and reserve exclamation marks for occasional enthusiastic emphasis.
Keep technical terms tied to plain-language benefits; use numerals for quantities and uppercase for prominent CTA labels.

audiences.need: A convenient, fast, and affordable way to certify English proficiency.

audiences.name: Curious learners
audiences.need: Expert answers, beginner guidance, and explanations of how learning works.
